name: Pan-Fried Pork Chop with Crispy Green Beans & Creamy Potato Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g new potatoes
454 g green beans
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pork chops, boneless
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
While the chops are cooking, trim green beans. Place in a medium bowl, along with oil and spices, then stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chops are done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and charred in some places, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside a ¼-cup dressing for the kid plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp granulated sugar
½ tsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pickles. Add to the bowl.

When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander. Place 1 cup of potatoes in a small bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to coat; set aside. Rinse remaining potatoes under cold water to cool, add to the bowl with the dressing, and stir to combine the potato salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide sliced pork chop and plain potatoes between plates, along with 1 cup of the green beans. Dip green bean "fries" in reserved dressing. 

FOR THE ADULTS: Divide remaining pork chops, green beans, and potato salad between plates. Enjoy!
